_regression.source: real map: Sawada (scripted hamlet) as generated 2026-08-15 with the VERTEX-only supply-bank hem - settlement-review caught the residue the vertex test cannot see: at the acute junction of branch 6 and the supply canal, wedge plots 359/360 keep every corner dry while their two long edges converge THROUGH the canal (crossings at (1401,2981), (1367,2982), (1348,2982), (1428,2974)); plot 673 crosses branch 9's tail at (140,2602). The rule is the GM's own: a bund bordering the irrigated channel runs along the water's edge, never through the water - so both the carve's quad drop and the gate walk each bund EDGE, not just its vertices.
